partnership_announcements.description: Brex and Tekion formed a new partnership to embed Brex's corporate card and spend management infrastructure into Tekion's Automotive Retail Cloud as Tekion Spend, extending Brex's reach into automotive dealer groups and enhancing Tekion's end-to-end retail platform.

press_references.value: Brex Helps Power OpenAI Global Spend and Financial Operations

partnership_announcements.description: Brex and OpenAI have formed a strategic partnership under which OpenAI uses Brex’s AI-native corporate card and spend management platform to run its global spend and financial operations.

press_references.value: Brex Brings AI-Native Accounting Automation to ERPs

partnership_announcements.description: Brex announced new integrations of its AI-native Accounting API with AI ERP platforms Rillet and Campfire, enabling real-time, two-way accounting data sync for joint customers.

press_references.value: Fifth Third Bank Embeds Brex’s Payments Infrastructure

partnership_announcements.description: Brex and Fifth Third Bank entered a multiyear commercial partnership where Fifth Third will use Brex Embedded payments infrastructure to power its new Fifth Third Commercial Card and provide Brex’s AI-driven spend management platform to its commercial clients.

press_references.value: Brex Announces Partnership with Oracle as First Fintech Global Issuer to Power B2B Payments in Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP

partnership_announcements.description: Brex announced a new partnership with Oracle to embed Brex virtual cards as the first fintech global issuer within Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP’s embedded B2B payments, enabling joint customers to select Brex cards in payables workflows and improve control, speed, and compliance.

press_references.value: Brex Partners with DoorDash for Business to Deliver DashPass to Brex Corporate Cardholders

partnership_announcements.description: Brex announced a strategic partnership with DoorDash for Business to provide DashPass memberships and 5% back in DoorDash credits to U.S.-based Brex corporate cardholders, adding food delivery perks to Brex cards.

overview_description.description: Brex is a financial technology company that is revolutionizing the way businesses manage their financial operations. By offering a comprehensive platform that seamlessly integrates financial services into existing software applications. Brex empowers employees to make informed financial decisions that drive business growth and success. With a focus on innovation and user-centric design. Brex is helping companies navigate the complexities of the modern business landscape and unlock their full potential.

about_short_description.short_description: Brex is a financial service and technology company that provides business credit cards and cash management accounts.

product.name: Brex Corporate Cards
product.description: Corporate and commercial card programs for business spending, with configurable budgets, spending limits, approvals, and global transaction support.

product.name: Brex Business Account
product.description: A business cash-management account combining checking, treasury, and vault services for holding cash, making payments, and managing company liquidity.

product.name: Brex Expense Management
product.description: An expense management system that automates receipt capture, expense preparation, approvals, policy enforcement, reimbursements, and real-time spend tracking.

product.name: Brex Travel
product.description: A corporate travel management service with in-app booking, itinerary management, expense integration, and support for global business travel programs.

product.name: Brex Bill Pay
product.description: An accounts-payable service that automates invoice data entry, approval workflows, vendor payments, and controlled vendor-specific card issuance.

product.name: Brex Accounting Automation
product.description: Accounting automation software for expense coding, accruals, close processes, financial suggestions, and two-way ERP integrations.
